recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中央有一顆核大、染色質細緻、胞質藍而無顆粒的原始細胞（blast），周圍為染色質粗顆粒、胞質深藍的紅血球前驅細胞及含顆粒的骨髓球，提示原始細胞增加的 MDS。
features: Central blast with large round nucleus, fine chromatin and a thin rim of agranular blue cytoplasm
Early erythroid precursors with coarsely granular chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Myelocytes with oval nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Orthochromatic normoblasts with dense pyknotic nuclei
No Auer rods or obvious megaloblastoid change identifiable in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a blast with a large round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, surrounded by basophilic erythroid precursors, myelocytes and orthochromatic normoblasts. No Auer rods are identified. Definite dysplastic features are not conspicuous in this single field, and the blast percentage cannot be derived from it. In the context of cytopenias and a 500-cell differential showing 5-19% blasts, findings would be consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts.

ddx.vs: Proerythroblasts have deeper blue cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing and coarser chromatin, unlike the paler agranular cytoplasm and fine chromatin of a myeloblast.
Promyelocytes are larger with abundant azurophilic granules and a paranuclear hof, whereas blasts are agranular or have only a few granules.
Normal marrow contains fewer than 5% blasts, so an increase must be established by a formal differential count rather than a single field.
